correctness.rationale: Hardy monomial action gives T e_{Mj}=q^j e_{Nj}, including common-divisor reduction and zero constant commutator. The signed diagonal is the difference of two progression Gram diagonals, with shared indices M N ell. Independently checked exact finite rational series trace and squared Hilbert-Schmidt formulas for four reduced pairs; strict decay recovers max(M,N) and sum(M,N) from the two invariants. All-p limit is justified by Riemann sums and beta substitution, not finite truncations.
